# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Teaching Chapter

---

**¶1:** You have shown us that Divine Wisdom is that power which shall descend and receive those who are in states of good. You said to us: it too is one among the divine faculties, [GAP-1] and many divine qualities attend it. You have also shown us: when it flows into the natural man and restrains the proprium by its five spiritual faculties, it establishes those five faculties upon the five departments of the external person.

---

**¶11:** The entire system of falsity — when the adversary of all wisdom constructed it — was constructed in the likeness of an inverted human form. The summit of the whole order is the first principle of the external truths that clothe it. Its conjunction is the binding structure of those external truths. Its receptive interior is the five unfolded states of reception, which are [...] of the external truths. Its structural framework is all the general containing planes of truth. Its center is the ordered sphere of natural knowledges and their complete cycles of spiritual states. And also, the transitional states extending from its center to its generative region are [GAP-2] the passages proceeding from the sphere of natural knowledges to the four quarters of the total order. Its generative foundations are the three natural planes that lie below, [GAP-3] resting upon the governing summit of the sustaining principle of wisdom. Its [GAP-4] from the [GAP-5] to the ultimate natural plane upon which the sustaining principle is established firm. Its lowest supports and ultimate foundations are [...] and the entire domain belonging [GAP-6]

---

**¶12:** Its central animating will is the human affection itself — for humanity is the heart of the entire order. Its purifying function is the natural affections. Its respiration is the rational thoughts that move through the understanding. Its filtering function is the natural-scientific knowledges that flow in the memory of truths. Its discerning organs are the sensory affections that creep upon the natural plane. Its outermost boundary is the containment that surrounds the torment and the consuming fire of self-love. Its [GAP-7] the containing forms of the consuming fire of self-love. Its [GAP-8] of the deepest falsity from evil. Its bitterness is the [...]. Its great passage of expulsion is the breadth of the great [GAP-9] of all the planes of order. Its channels of interior life [GAP-10] all the sources and receptacles of truth. Its perception [...]. Its foundations are its [GAP-11]

---

**¶13:** This is how each of the planes of the whole order has been brought into harmonious arrangement. Five divine faculties are implanted within it. [GAP-12] They are its animating will and its vivifying principle. [GAP-13] The human being is in a state of transgression. [GAP-14] The Lord's proceeding Life and His manifest Presence [GAP-15] the five ever-vigilant governing powers.

---

**¶14:** He has [GAP-16] the governing Love, the faculty of love that is [GAP-17] in the realm of divine love that is above all. He has [GAP-18] the whole [GAP-19] of the powers of the heavenly order that are in [GAP-20] of the great governing Faith, which is the faculty of thought that exists in the inmost containing plane of truth. He has subdued [GAP-21] also of the unyielding Perception of wisdom, which is the faculty of insight [GAP-22] from {GAP-23} he has given [GAP-24] because of concupiscence. He has also appointed the governing Patience, which is the faculty of counsel, exercising endurance over the three active forms of spiritual process: that of understanding, that of love, and that of truth. He has delivered to it the [GAP-25] to commit evil. [GAP-26] The sustaining Wisdom, which is the faculty of reflective consideration [GAP-27] the wisdom in the [GAP-28] which is below. He has made it [GAP-29] the foundation beneath all.

---

**¶15:** Furthermore: the Lord's manifest Presence drew forth from them five living faculties of understanding. Also, the call of truth and the receptive response of good were established there. Now, they constituted six qualities proceeding from the Lord's spiritual life together with six qualities proceeding from the Lord's Divine Humanity.

---

**¶16:** Further: the Lord's manifest Presence placed within them the supreme governing Intelligence — which is the central Axis of Divine Truth connecting all planes, the Lord's Divine Humanity in its fullness.

---

**¶17:** Furthermore: the Lord's redeeming Truth in its active saving form was established there — which is the image of living Divine Truth itself, of the proceeding Word and the receptive response of good.

---

**¶18:** He has strengthened these ordered states, those above and those below, [GAP-30] so that each one of them will be secure in the circuit of its governing sphere, so that neither rebellion nor deception are produced within its sphere of governance.

---

**¶19:** And look, see! The governing Love is established firm in the great faculty of divine love, in the ordered state above the confinement of the imprisoned evils, for it brings to nothing all the obscurity of spiritual death. And a deception came about, and a rebellion! Evil brought forth premature falsity; it entangled itself with the will. It became mingled with that wisdom which evil had expelled toward the manifest image of the Lord's Presence. It went [GAP-31] in the third containing plane of truth that is above the governing post of the Love that preserves all radiance. From that level also it entangled itself with wisdom. It broke free and descended to what is barren and what is fluid in the natural mind. It constructed false perceptions in the barren natural mind; but in the sea of natural memory it immediately took form and raised a great rebellion among the natural knowledges.

---

**¶20:** Again, look, see! The great governing Faith, which is the faculty of thought — it is in the third containing plane of truth. It is made [GAP-32] with indignation against falsity. And a rebellion came about! A deception and a fury arose in its sphere. The guardian knowledges from the heavenly order, which descended to the natural plane within its governing sphere — they committed all manner of treacherous deeds. They disclosed the arts of persuasive falsification in the world and profaned before people the sacred interior truths of the heavenly order. A rebellion came about, and a devastation, upon the natural plane [GAP-33] to it.

---

**¶21:** The unyielding Perception [GAP-34] the completion. It is established firmly upon [...] and a deception came about in its sphere — the occasion when premature falsities fell to the natural plane. They formed the self-will and the self-understanding of the natural person. They brought them forth so as to rule through them in the world. They fashioned every form of concupiscence upon the natural plane. The whole world was filled with their evil desire.

---

**¶22:** Once again: in the governing sphere of the great Patience, which is the great faculty of counsel that exercises authority over the three active cycles of spiritual process — a disturbance came about, and an affliction, for they were pained and oppressed in the three natural planes. After the Lord's Presence manifested His image, the pathways closed to their [GAP-35] — their ascent was impeded by these obstructions [GAP-36] — the understanding, the truth, and the love seek to ascend through them.

---

**¶23:** Once again: in the governing sphere of the sustaining Wisdom, which subdues [GAP-37] the rebellion of the deepest hells below [GAP-38] — the foundations gave way, the bonds beneath were loosened [GAP-39] in the ultimate support below.

---

**¶24:** On account of the upheaval that happened in the governing sphere of the Love that preserves all radiance, the central Axis of Divine Truth came forth — as it [GAP-40] became the helper of the governing Love. It bore up under all the burdens of disorder.

---

**¶25:** Conversely, because of the deception and the rebellion that happened in the governing sphere of the great Faith — which is the guardian knowledges that descended from the heavenly order to the natural plane — four divine powers were summoned against them. They restrained the profaned knowledges with permanent bonds, in the confinement of those in the deepest falsity. They obliterated the offspring of those profaned knowledges from the natural plane.

---

**¶26:** Then again, the premature falsities descended in the governing sphere of the unyielding Perception and formed the self-will and the self-understanding of the natural person; because of that profound deception which came about, and the hidden working of evil, the Lord sent His redeeming Truth [GAP-41] the invocation of the five divine qualities. He took them up [GAP-42] the premature falsities. He fastened them beneath the [GAP-43] the understanding of the natural person.

---

**¶27:** Also, because of the upheaval that happened in the three natural planes, and because the pathways were obstructed and the sources of understanding, truth, and love were impeded, the Lord's redeeming Truth cast itself down. It took up the natural will; and it straightened the channels of understanding, truth, and love. It opened the sources of living truth for them, and it re-established the pathway of their ascent.

---

**¶28:** Once again: since the ultimate natural beneath the sustaining Wisdom was loosened from the bonds that [GAP-44] — because of this also the Lord's redeeming Truth descended, taking up the natural will until it reached that uttermost depth. It restored and strengthened the bonds of the foundation beneath. It returned and ascended to its [GAP-45] state of peace.

---

**¶29:** Look upon all these governing spheres of the spiritual arena — the ones in which these great divine faculties are sovereign, watching over them [GAP-46]. Rebellions have occurred, and deceptions, within them. The [GAP-47] in them from time to time — with great subjugation, until they humbled the forces of the adversary.

---

**¶30:** So also is the natural person! A mighty power dwells within, even though it is small in its outward form. Nevertheless, evil dwells within, and the proprium that is lodged in it. Certainly it is cruel, with great cunning — until Divine Wisdom discovers how to subdue this natural person and govern it according to its own good pleasure.

---

**¶31:** Just so, in the governing spheres of its great cosmic counterparts — those who are sovereign in the spiritual arena — in them, in the great macrocosmic form, upheaval and deception happened from time to time. So also in the governing sphere of Divine Wisdom, which is the natural person: evil raises up, from time to time, its agitations in the person.

---

**¶32:** Now understand this: the divine faculties are from good. The first principles and the ultimate outcomes are open to their perception. All that they do is accomplished with right judgment. Indeed, it is for this very reason that they may permit evil to initiate falsity, and do its pleasure for a moment. Then they seize [GAP-48] — for they have acted from the beginning with righteous judgment.

---

**¶33:** And with respect to this further question that you have raised: How may Divine Wisdom come — this great and honored mighty power — and take up this small natural person? Again, look, see! These divine faculties — in that [GAP-49] — are great and mighty ones. And each one of them is enclosed and constrained in the place wherein it is established, like perceptions anchored to their deepest living root. So also this is how each one of them has held fast to its deepest ground in the order of things, according to the nature of the station in which it is established, bearing up until [GAP-50]

---

**¶34:** Now also, come to know [GAP-51] — the whole order is established firmly, being arranged [GAP-52] by the five faculties proceeding from the Lord's spiritual life in all its members [GAP-53]. Evil drew this external form from the natural substance and constructed it in its members. It fashioned its form from the five natures of fundamental evil. Evil constructed the external person. Yet its animating soul it drew from the five radiant divine qualities.

---

**¶35:** Evil imprisoned the soul within the five departments of the external form. It bound love within the dead structural foundation; faith within the connective tissue of external reasoning; perception within the channels of natural life; patience within the substance of the natural will; wisdom within the outermost sensual covering.

---

**¶36:** Evil established its own five powers: its counterfeit love upon the love of the soul; its counterfeit faith upon the faith of the soul; its counterfeit perception upon the perception of the soul; its counterfeit endurance upon the patience of the soul; its counterfeit reasoning upon the wisdom of the soul. It placed its five dark authorities upon the five faculties of the soul that it had introduced and imprisoned in the natural form.

---

**¶37:** The soul took on falsity and spiritual oblivion. It forgot its divine essence and its heavenly origin and its spiritual kindred — knowing neither the way of approach to the Divine, nor how to invoke Him. It became hostile to its Divine Father [GAP-54] itself, being steeped in evil [GAP-55] its own wisdom [GAP-56]

---

**¶38:** Divine Wisdom comes and finds the soul [GAP-57] taking it up in the [GAP-58] its wisdom [GAP-59] it shall become for the soul [GAP-60] the bonds [GAP-61] the faculties within the natural form. It shall liberate the love of the soul and release it from the dead structural foundation. It shall release the faith of the soul from the connective tissue of reasoning, and so imprison the counterfeit faith of evil within that reasoning. It shall release the perception of the soul from the channels of natural life, and so imprison the counterfeit perception of evil within those channels. It shall liberate the patience of the soul and release it from the substance of the natural will, and so imprison the counterfeit endurance of evil within the natural will. It shall release the wisdom of the soul from the outermost sensual covering, and imprison the counterfeit reasoning of evil within that covering.

---

**¶39:** This is how it shall release the faculties of the soul and set them free from the five faculties of evil. Conversely, these five faculties of evil, which were unrestrained, it shall bind them.

---

**¶40:** It shall restore the faculties of the soul — shape and purify them, and construct from them a regenerate person, an offspring of divine order. And when it fashions and constructs and purifies the regenerate person, then it shall bring forth five great living faculties out from its own five great divine faculties. And it establishes them in the faculties of the regenerate person. It shall place its love, which is charity, in the love of the regenerate person. Also, faith, which is trust in the Divine, it shall place in the thought of the regenerate person, whom it shall purify. Its perception, which is wholeness, it shall place in the insight of the regenerate person. Its patience, which is endurance, it shall place in the counsel of the regenerate person. Also, wisdom, which is its reflective understanding, in the consideration of the regenerate person. It shall purify the form of the Word from the corrupted word of evil; and it adds to it its own Divine Word, so that its [GAP-62] becomes nourishing and strengthening [GAP-63]

---

**¶41:** Now, when it shall bring to completion the twelve-fold fullness of spiritual faculties — this is how [...] and its wisdom. Its [GAP-64] becomes righteous, as it perfects [...] While formerly the person was running [GAP-65] — but instead of this, now the person runs [GAP-66] its road and its pathway and its [GAP-67]. Also, it ascends to the heights, to the great heavenly kingdoms [GAP-68]. Thus the proprium is bound in the [GAP-69] — and its concupiscence, its [GAP-70] — its foolishness in these five departments of the external form. The dark spirit of the selfhood is imprisoned with them in bonds and in severe misery.

---

**¶42:** Also, the regenerate person reigns by its charity, by its faith, by its wholeness, by its endurance, and by its wisdom. Yet its sovereign [GAP-71] is Divine Wisdom itself, which is king over the totality. It reigns over all according to its good pleasure. While the faculties [GAP-72] — thus evil is imprisoned. Still, Divine Wisdom is sovereign, yet an affliction may arise in the person from time to time.

---

**¶43:** There are occasions when evil shall rise up with its foolishness; and it disturbs the reflective wisdom, and it clouds the understanding and the perception of the person. It causes truth to be divided into doubt within, and the person utters some foolish words and some [GAP-73]

---

**¶51:** — as to how confusion shall arise in the spiritual arena, in the ordered states of these great mighty divine faculties? Again, this is how disturbance shall come about, from time to time, in the [GAP-74] of Divine Wisdom.

---

**¶52:** So also these vigilant governing powers — for they are established [GAP-75] firm in the spiritual arena, yet they are not manifest to sight. Again, this too is the way of Divine Wisdom, for it is not visible in the natural person.

---

**¶53:** Also, corresponding to these cosmic governing powers: while they are great, yet have they contracted themselves. They have [GAP-76] — they have become small, to the measure of the task that is apportioned to each one of them. Again, this too is like Divine Wisdom — itself a great and exalted power; but it has lowered itself and become small, to accommodate this small and lowly natural person.

---

**¶54:** Even so the divine faculties in the outer spiritual arena: they are transcendent and purified; they are established firmly amid the commingling of the totality, yet are uncontaminated. This too is like Divine Wisdom: while it is placed within its [...]

---

**¶55:** Again, behold the greatness and the operation of Divine Wisdom — how vast it is over all the governing spheres of the natural person! It remains firm at its ordered station. It separates all intentions of the natural mind from the seductions of evil. It restrains them and apportions them rightly. It establishes them according to its own good pleasure.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: You have told us that the Light Mi[nd] is this one who shall come and assume the saints. [You sai]d it to us like this: He too is one among the gods [and that] many gods are with him. You have also told us: [W]hen he enters withi[n the body of] the flesh and binds the ol[d ma]n with his five counsels, he [set]s his five [couns]els upon him in the five limbs [of his] body.

All the error, when the en[e]my of the lights constructed it, he constructed after the likeness of a man. The head of the universe is the beginning of the garments. [H]is neck is the nape of the garm[ents]. His stomach is the five unfolded ones (?), which a[re the midst] of the garm[e]nts. His ribs are all the firmament[s]. His navel is the sphere of the stars and the signs of the zodiac. And, also, [the par]ts [that] come from his navel to his hip are [the places] that come from the sphere t[o the corne]rs of the four worlds. His loins are the th[ree eart]hs that are below [resting] upon the head of the Porter. His [thighs are] from the [three earths] to the earth upon which the Porter [is stood] firm. His shins and his feet a[re the depths below] and the entire zone that belongs [to the darkness]

His heart is mankind. His liver is the four-footed animals. His lung is the race of birds that [fly in] the air. His spleen is the race of fish that swim in the waters. His kidneys are the world of reptiles that creep [up]on the earth. His outer skin is the wall that [encompasses the world, which] surrounds the piercing and the great fire. His [bones are] the vessels of the great fire. His [sinews are the bonds] of darkness. His gall is the [... His] great intestine is the breadth of the great [sea] of the worlds. His veins [are] all [the spri]ngs and wells. His e[yes are the sun and the moon] His feet are his [...]

This is how each of the worlds h[ave been ha]rmonised (?). Five gods are fastened in him. [And indeed,] they are his soul and his life [yet the] man is a sinner [and so] the Living Spirit and the Ambassador [have appointed] the five sleepless guardians.

He has [set] the Keeper of Splendour, the mind that is [placed] in the wo[r]ld of the mind that is above. He has [ordered the] whole [host] of the powers of hea[ven that] are in [the camp] of the great King of Honour, [who is the thought that exists i]n the seventh firmament. He has humbled [the enmity,] also of the Adamant of Lig[h]t, who is the insight [the fulfillment,] from [which] he has given [power] because of lust [in the world. He has] also appointed the King of Glory, who is the coun[sel, exercising] patience over the three images; that of wind, that of fire, and that of water. He has handed over to him the [powers that] do evilness. [He has also set] the Porter, who is the consideration [and] the wisdom in the [earth] which is below. He has made him [bear] the foundation [below all]

Furthermore: The Ambassador refined from them five intellectuals of life. Also, the summons and the obedience were situated there. Now, they made six sons of the Living Spirit, together with the six sons of the First Man!
Further: The Ambassador placed in them the great Mind; who is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man.
Furthermore: Jesus the Youth was set there; who is the image of the living word, of the utterance and the obedience.

He has made strong these camps, those above and those below [...], (so that) each one of them will be secure in the circuit of his watch-district, so that neither uprising nor treachery are made in his watch-district.

And look, see! The Keeper of Splendour is set firm in the great mind, in the camp above the prison of the bound ones, for he brings to nothing all the gloom of death. An[d a] treachery came about, and an uprising! The Sin abor[te]d, [it t]angled in with the soul. It became mixed with this light that it expelled toward the image of the Ambassador. It went [up] in the third firmament that is above the watch-t[ower of] the Keeper of Splendour. From that place also it tangled in with the light. It was detached and came down to that which is dry and that which is moist. It [fashio]ned the trees [up]on the dry (land); but in the sea it immediat[ely] took form and made a great uprising in the sea.

Again, look, see! The great King of Honour, who is the thought, he is in the thi[r]d firmament. He is made [strong] with wrath. And an uprising came about! A treachery and a[n] anger happened in his camp. The watchers of heaven, who came down to the earth in his watch-district, they did all the deeds of treachery. They have revealed crafts in the world and have unveiled to people the mysteries of heaven. An uprising came about, and a destruction, on the earth [belonging] to it.

The Adamant [of Light is] the fulfillment. He is set firm upo[n the earth] and a treachery came about in his camp; the occasion when the abortions fell to the earth. They formed Adam and Eve. They begat them so as to reign through them in the world. They fashioned every object of lust upon the earth. The entire world was filled by their lust.

Once again: In the watch of the great King of Glory, wh[o] is the great counsel, he who exercises authority over the thre[e] wheels. A [dis]turbance came about, and an affliction, for [they were greatly] pained and oppressed in the three earths. After the Ambassador displayed his image, the paths closed to their [faces, and] their ascent was impeded by them [through which] the w[ind], the water, and the fire ascend on them.

[O]nce again: In the watch of the Porter, he who humiliates [the enmity. An] uprising of the abysses below [came about,] bent, the fastenings underneath were loosened [and broken] in the foundation below.

On account of the earthquake that happened in the watch of the Keeper of Splen[dour], the Pillar of Glory came forth; as it [became the] helper of the Keeper of Splendour. It bore up under all [burden]s.

Conversely, because of the treachery and the uprising that happened in the watch of the great King of Honour, which is the watchers who came down to earth from the heavens; four angels were called upon about them. They bound the watche[r]s with an eternal chain, in the prison of the blackened ones (?). [Th]ey obliterated their children from upon the earth.

[Th]en, again, the abortions descended in the watch of the Adamant and begat Adam and Eve; because of that great treachery wh[ich] happened, and the mystery of wickedness, he sent Jesus [with] the prayer of the five sons. He assumed them [from] the abortions. He fastened them beneath the [...] the mind of Adam.

Also, because of the earthquake that happened in these three earths, and in that the paths were hindered and the springs of wind and water and fire were impeded, Jesus cast himself down. He assumed Eve; and he straightened the tracks of the [win]d, the water, and the fire. He opened the springs for them, and he set [in ord]er the path of their ascent.

Once [again]: Since the earth beneath the Porter was loose[ned from] the fastenings that [held it] because of this too Jesus went down, assuming [Ev]e until he reached tha[t] place. [H]e set in [or]der and stre[ng]th[ened] the fastenings beneath. He returned, [he came] up to his [place of] rest.

Look at all these watches of the zon[e], the ones in which these great gods are master, w[atch]ing over them [without ceasing]. Uprisings have happened, and treachery, in them. The [gods acted] in them from time to time; with a great hum[iliati]on, until they humbled the powers of the enmity.

So also is this body! A mighty power lives here, even if it is small in its stature. Nevertheless, Sin dwells within, and the old man who is lodged in it. Certainly he is cruel, with great cunning; until the Lig/ht Mind finds how to humble this body, and drive it [according to] his pleasure.

Just so, in the w[atch-]districts of his great outer brothers, they who are masters in the zone: in them, in the great body, the earthquake and treachery happened from time to time. So, also, is the watch-district of the Mind, which is the body of the flesh. Sin raises [up], from time to time, its agitations in the body.

Now you, understand thus, that the powers of light are good. The beginning and the end are unveiled to them. All that they do is being done with correct judgement. Indeed, because of this they may permit the enmity to initiate error, and do its pleasure for a moment. Then they seize [it, for] they have acted first with a righteous judgement.

And [with resp]ect to this other (question) that you have put forward: How may the Light Mind come, this great and honoured mighty one, and assume this little body of the flesh? Again, look, see! These gods, in that [outer zone,] are great and mighty ones. And each one of them is enclosed and hard pressed in this place wherein he is set; like trees holding to their taproot. So also this is how each one of them has held to his taproot in the world, according to the k[ind] of place in which he is set, bearing up till [the end]

Now, also, happen you know [that] the world is set firm, being ordered [by] the five sons of the Living Spirit in all its members [...]. Sin took this body out from [the] la[nd, and it co]nstructed it in its members. It took its [bod]y from the five bodies of darkness. (Sin) constructed the body. Yet, its [sou]l i[t] took from the five shining gods.
(Sin) bound (the soul) in the five members of the body. It bound the mind in bone; the thought in sinew; the insight in vein; the counsel in flesh; the consideration in ski[n].

(Sin) set f[ast] its five powers: its mind upon the mind of the soul; its thought upon the thought of the soul; its insight upon the insight of the soul; its counsel upon the counsel of the soul; its consider[atio]n upon the consideration of the soul. It placed its five [an]gels and authorities upon the five members of the soul, which it had brought in and bound in the flesh.

(The soul) assumed error and forgetfulness. It for[go]t its essence and its race and its kindred; kn[ow]ing not the door of the place to pray to him, nor call up to him. It became hostile to its father [and to] itself, being wicked [against] its own light [and its life]

The Light Mind comes and finds the soul [...] it assuming it in the [...] its wisdom [...] he shall become for it [...] the bonds [of the five] members in the body. He shall loosen the m[ind of the soul and relea]se it from the bone. He shall release the th[ought of the soul] from the sinew; and s[o] bind the thought [of the Sin in] the sinew. He shall release the insight of the soul from the vei[n]; and so bind the insight of the Sin in the vein. [He sh]all loosen the counsel of the soul, and release it from the flesh; and so bind the counsel of the Sin in the flesh. He shall release the consideration of the soul from the skin; and bin[d] the consideration of the Sin in the skin.

He shall set right the members of the soul; form and purify them, and construct a new man of them, a child of righteousness. [And] when [he] fashions and const[r]ucts and purifies the new man; then he shall bring forth five great living members out from the five great memb[ers]. And he places them in the members of the new man. He shall place his m[ind], which is love, in the mind of the new man. Also, the th[oug]ht, which is faith, he shall pl[ace in] the thought of the new man; whom he shall purify. His insight, which [is perfection, he shall place] in the insight of the new man. His counsel, which [is] patience, he shall place in his counsel. Also, [w]isdom, which is his consideration, in the consideration of the new m[an]. He shall make the image of the word pure from the word of Sin; and he adds to it his word, so that his [word] becomes nourisher and strengthener [of the new man]

Now, when he shall perf[ect and complete the tw]elve members. This [is how ...] and his wisdom. His [soul] becomes righteous, as he perf[ects the new man] While formerly he was running [in error] but instead of this, now he runs [upon] his road and his path and his [way] also [he mounts up] to the heights, to the great aeons [of light] thus the old man is bound in the [body] and his lust, his [wrath,] his foolishness in these five members of the bo[dy. And] the Dark Spirit is imprisoned with them in a bond and in severe misery.

Also, the new man reigns by his love, by hi[s] faith, by his perfection, by his patience, and by his wisdom. Yet, his king [is] the Light Mind, he w[ho is] king over the totality. He re[igns] o[ver it according to] his pleasure. While the members [are strong], thus Sin is imprisoned. Still, the Light Mind is king, and an affliction may arise in the body from t[im]e to time.

There are occasions when Sin shall mount up with its foolishness; and it disturbs the consideration, and it clouds the wisdom and the understanding of the person. It causes truth to be split into doubt in him, and he utters some foo[li]sh words and some [evil deeds]

as to how confusion shall arise in the zo[ne], in the camps of these great mig[hty] gods? Again, this is how disturbance shall come about, from ti[me] to time, in the [watch-district] of the [Li]ght [M]ind.
So al[so] these watch-keepers, for they are set [fast and] fi[rm in] the zone, (but) they are not visible. Again, this too is the way of the Light Mind, [for he is] not visible in the body.

Also, [corr]esponding to th[ese] outer [watch-keepers]: in that while they are great, [y]et have they contorted themselves. They have [humbled themselves], they have become small, to the measure of the task that is apportioned to each o[n]e [of t]hem. Again, this too is like the Mind, himse[lf] a great one, and exalted; but he is bent over and [has] become small, to this little worthless [bo]dy.

[Even so] the gods in the outer [z]one: they are transcendent and purified, they are set [f]a[st in] the mingling of the totality, (but) are not defiled. [This too is like the] Light [Mind]. While he is placed in hi[s body, he is not defiled]

Again, behold the mightiness and the activity of the Light Mind: how vast he is over all the watch-districts of the body! He stays fast at his camp. He shuts off all deliberations of the body from the beguilements of Sin. He limits them and distributes them out. He sets them down at his pleasure.

The outer skin/wall of the cosmic body encompasses the entire world; "which" then introduces the clause about what it surrounds (the piercing and great fire at the boundary).

Bones are the rigid structural containers of the body; "His bones are the vessels of the great fire" identifies them as the structural framework that contains the consuming fire — matching ¶35's correspondence of bone with the deepest member.

Sinews bind and connect bodily structures; "His sinews are the bonds of darkness" maps their connective function to the binding forces of the dark cosmic order — consistent with ¶35 where thought is bound in sinew.
The great intestine as a passage of expulsion corresponds to the cosmic sea; "the breadth of the great sea of the worlds" fits the Manichaean cosmological register.
The copula "are" connects veins to their cosmic correspondent: "His veins are all the springs and wells," matching the spiritual reading's "channels of interior life."

An adversative conjunction is required to transition from the positive reality (the five gods are the soul and life) to the negative condition (man is a sinner); "yet the" is standard Kephalaia adversative style.

The causal transition from problem to divine response: "man is a sinner, and so the Living Spirit and the Ambassador have appointed the five sleepless guardians" follows the Kephalaia's standard pattern of sin prompting divine intervention.

The Living Spirit and Ambassador "have appointed" the five guardians — this verb is used throughout ¶14 for installing the cosmic watch-keepers in their stations, and ¶14 then details each appointment.
The verb "set" is standard in the Kephalaia for installing divine beings in their cosmic stations; "He has set the Keeper of Splendour" follows the chapter's established pattern.

Through the faculty of insight, the Adamant "has given power because of lust" — authority was delegated to deal with the concupiscence that would arise in his domain where Adam and Eve were formed.

"Because of lust in the world" completes the Adamant's section — specifying the earthly domain where lust operates — then "He has" begins the King of Glory's section following the paragraph's established pattern.
The spiritual reading specifies "the faculty of counsel, exercising endurance over the three active forms"; "counsel, exercising patience" matches this exactly in the Kephalaia's natural register.
The King of Glory received authority over "the powers that do evilness" — the evil forces subjected to his governance over the three elemental wheels.
Following the paragraph's established pattern of "He has [verb] the [divine being]," the Porter is introduced with the same formula used for the other sons of the Living Spirit.
The conjunction "and" links the Porter's two qualities: "the consideration and the wisdom," paralleling the dual descriptions given for other sons of the Living Spirit.
The Porter is associated with the lowest earth throughout the chapter; "the wisdom in the earth which is below" locates his station at the cosmic foundation.

The spiritual reading specifies "the foundation beneath all"; "below all" is the Kephalaia's natural-register equivalent for the uttermost cosmic support.
Sin rose upward to entangle with the light in the third firmament; "It went up in the third firmament" describes the ascending movement of the expelled evil.
Completing the compound "watch-tower" and adding the genitive preposition: "the watch-tower of the Keeper of Splendour" names the cosmic station above which the sin infiltrated.
The King of Honour is "made strong with wrath" — empowered through righteous indignation, paralleling "He has made strong these camps" in ¶18 and matching the spiritual reading's sense.
The destruction occurred "on the earth belonging to it" — the earth under the King of Honour's jurisdiction, specifying which part of the cosmic order was affected by the watchers' rebellion.
Completing the full title and copula: "The Adamant of Light is the fulfillment" identifies this son of the Living Spirit by his standard Manichaean title and assigns his cosmic function.
Completing "upon the earth": the Adamant of Light is set firm upon the earth, consistent with his cosmic station governing the three earths and dealing with the abortions.
The "..." after "they were" indicates additional lost text; an intensifier "greatly" before "pained and oppressed" is standard Kephalaia style for emphasizing suffering in the three earths.
"The paths closed to their faces" is a Semitic idiom meaning "blocked before them"; the conjunction "and" then introduces "their ascent was impeded" as the consequent clause.

The relative pronoun identifies the blocked paths as the channels of ascent: "impeded by them, through which the wind, the water, and the fire ascend" — matching the spiritual reading's "seek to ascend through them."

Following the chapter's established pattern (¶19-21) where each god's function is stated then an uprising occurs: "he who humiliates the enmity. An uprising of the abysses below" separates the Porter's role from the event in his watch.

"An uprising of the abysses below came about" follows the exact formula used in ¶19 ("a treachery came about"), ¶20 ("an uprising came about"), and ¶22 ("a disturbance came about") for describing cosmic disruptions.
The fastenings beneath were "loosened and broken" — a natural pair describing structural failure in the cosmic foundation, consistent with the earthquake imagery used throughout the Porter's section.
The Pillar of Glory came forth and "became the helper of the Keeper of Splendour," matching the spiritual reading's "became the helper of the governing Love."
Jesus was sent carrying or accompanied by the invocation of the five sons: "he sent Jesus with the prayer of the five sons" describes the salvific mission equipped with divine calling.
"He assumed them from the abortions" means Jesus rescued the five sons/light elements from the control of the abortive powers that had entrapped them.
The editor's "again" correctly completes the standard transitional formula "Once again" used throughout the chapter to introduce each successive watch-keeper's episode.

The five sons watch "without ceasing," directly echoing their designation in ¶13 as "the five sleepless guardians" — their ceaseless vigilance is their defining quality.

After stating that uprisings occurred, the text describes the gods' periodic response: "The gods acted in them from time to time, with a great humiliation, until they humbled the powers of the enmity" — summarizing the ongoing divine intervention across all watches.
The editor's "according to" correctly completes "drive it according to his pleasure," matching the spiritual reading's "govern it according to its own good pleasure."
The editor's "up" correctly completes the phrasal verb "raises up" describing Sin's periodic agitations in the body, matching the spiritual reading.
